bulletPoints: 4 days in office, 1 day from home
Proven FMCG inventory management across 3PL network is essential
content.jobHook: A rare & exciting opportunity for an experienced Inventory Leader to join a highly reputable FMCG trading organisation based in Melbourne's South East
content.unEditedContent:
Pace Vic is proud to be the long standing exclusive recruitment partner of a market leading trading company based in Melbourne's South East. As a leader in their field, this organisation has built upon trust and forming long-term win-win partnerships throughout the dairy and meat industries and are now very excited to be expanding their tight-knit, committed team. This organisation is an experienced, globally expanding business who values professionalism, adaptability and holds workplace culture and adherence to company values as their top priorities.

A very rare and exciting opportunity has presented for an experienced Inventory Control Specialist / Lead to join and their dedicated team.

This is a varied role that will include:
  • Management of end-to-end inventory accuracy, integrity, and visibility across all 3PL warehouse locations. 
  • The owner of inventory master data integrity — ensuring that product data (units of measure, pack sizes, barcodes, carton quantities, pallet configurations) is accurate and maintained across systems.
  • Partnering with the Supply Chain Manager on 3PL governance.
  • Supporting Finance on month-end reconciliation and annual audit, and provides the trading team with accurate stock position data to support commercial decision-making.
  • Process improvement: identifying and implementing improvements to inventory management processes, systems, and controls to increase accuracy and reduce waste.
  • Champion best practice in stock control and master data management across the Supply Chain function and 3PL partner network.
About you:
  • 5+ years’ experience in inventory control within a 3PL or warehouse environment (imported goods experience highly regarded).
  • Experience with FEFO/FIFO management in perishable or shelf-life-controlled products.
  • Strong ERP experience required; (Microsoft Dynamics 365 preferred).
  • Advanced MS Excel skills; experience with Power BI desirable.
  • Detail-oriented with strong data discipline - experience maintaining product master data (UOMs, pack sizes, barcodes, pallet configurations).
  • Exceptional communication skills.
This role would be well suited to someone with 5+ years of Inventory Control experience, particular managing a network of 3PL's, who is looking to join a high performance environment experiencing sustained growth. This is an excellent opportunity to join a team who will value your ability to work independently, your commitment and your integrity, and step into a role where you're truly owning the management of inventory.
 
If you feel you could be the right fit for this role, please apply via the link or send us and email at apply@pacevic.com.au for more information. If you’re looking for a different role within our specialties and wish to engage our services, we’d love to hear from you. If you wish to discuss this role confidentially or other roles that we are currently recruiting for, please contact us on 03 9620 4000 or visit www.paceappointments.com.au. Note all applications will be treated with the strictest confidence.

bulletPoints: Support both Warehouse and Maintenance teams in a busy environment
content.jobHook: 12-month fixed-term opportunity for an experienced Warehouse Administrator to support operations in Blackwater. Working a 5/2/4/3 roster (7am-4pm)
content.unEditedContent:
Reporting to the Warehouse Supervisor, you will provide administrative support across the warehouse and maintenance functions, ensuring accurate receipting, reporting and data management to support site operations.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Warehouse department
  • Assisting with receipting of orders into the ERP system, resolving PO discrepancies and fulfilling work order pick slips
  • Supporting stocktakes and inventory activities
  • Providing administrative support to the Maintenance team and backfill coverage during leave or peak periods
  • Coordinating with Procurement and Accounts Payable to resolve PO, invoice and vendor issues
  • General administration including data entry, filing, archiving and record management
  • Delivering a high level of internal customer service across site
  • Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and supporting agreed initiatives
  • Ensuring compliance with site safety, environmental and company policies and procedures
You will bring:
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in an administrative role, ideally within a warehouse environment in mining or construction
  • Knowledge of parts and components used in heavy equipment maintenance an advantage
  • Strong data entry skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Intermediate Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • A proactive, team-focused approach with strong communication skills
  • Current QLD Class C Driver’s Licence

title: Stores / Inventory Manager

content.jobHook: An exciting and unique opportunity exists for a highly organised and proactive Stores / Inventory Manager to work on the beautiful Lindeman Island.
content.unEditedContent:
Stores / Inventory Manager - Lindeman Island

Position Title: Stores/Inventory Manager

Location: Lindeman Island, Whitsunday Islands, Queensland, Australia

Reporting To: Chief Engineer

Probation Period: 6 Months

Salary: $90K - $110K + Superannuation

Role Overview: We are seeking a meticulous and experienced professional to oversee all aspects of our island's inventory and stores operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the receipt, storage, issuance, and tracking of a diverse range of goods, from building materials and plant spare parts to hospitality supplies and consumables. Due to the remote nature of the location, exceptional planning, problem-solving skills, and a strong eye for detail are paramount to ensuring the island has what it needs, when it needs it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Inventory Management: Implement and maintain robust inventory control systems to accurately track stock levels for all departments (e.g., maintenance, hospitality, marine, general operations). This includes managing minimum and maximum stock levels, reorder points, and lead times.

  • Receiving & Dispatch: Coordinate the efficient receipt of all incoming goods, including offloading from barges/boats, inspecting for damage, verifying against purchase orders, and accurately recording deliveries. Manage the dispatch of goods as required.

  • Storage & Organisation: Optimise the layout and organisation of all storage areas and warehouses to ensure efficient use of space, easy accessibility, and proper storage conditions for various materials. Implement and maintain clear labelling systems.

  • Stock Control & Audits: Conduct regular stocktakes and cycle counts to ensure inventory accuracy. Investigate and reconcile discrepancies, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.

  • Procurement Support: Collaborate closely with the management team and various departments to understand their material requirements, assist with creating purchase requisitions, and provide data for purchasing decisions.

  • Dangerous Goods Management: Ensure the safe and compliant storage and handling of all dangerous goods and hazardous substances in accordance with Australian Standards and WHS regulations.

  • Asset Tracking: Assist with the tracking of island assets, including tools and equipment, ensuring their proper return and maintenance.

  • Waste Management Support: Assist in the coordination of waste management processes and logistics for removal from the island.

  • Reporting: Generate regular inventory reports, highlighting stock levels, consumption rates, discrepancies, and any potential supply chain issues.

  • Supplier Liaison: Maintain effective communication with suppliers regarding deliveries, discrepancies, and returns, always fostering positive relationships.

  • Safety & Compliance: Adhere to all Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) policies and procedures, ensuring a safe and tidy stores environment. Ensure all operations comply with relevant Australian Standards and regulations.

  • Process Improvement: Continuously review and improve stores and inventory processes to enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and minimise costs.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Proven Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years' experience in a similar stores, inventory, or warehousing management role, ideally within a diverse operational environment.

  • Inventory Systems: Demonstrated experience with inventory management software or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

  • Receiving & Dispatch: Solid experience in the efficient receipt, storage, and dispatch of goods, including experience with various types of freight.

  • Stock Control: Expertise in conducting accurate stocktakes, cycle counts, and reconciliation processes.

  • Forklift Licence: Current and valid Australian Forklift Licence (LF class) is essential.

  • Driver's Licence: Current and valid Australian Driver's Licence.

  • Dangerous Goods Knowledge: Understanding of dangerous goods storage and handling regulations.

Skills & Attributes:

  • Highly Organised: Exceptional organisational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Systematic Thinker: Ability to develop and implement logical and efficient processes.

  • Proactive & Resourceful: Capable of anticipating needs, identifying potential issues, and finding practical solutions in a remote setting.

  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address inventory discrepancies and logistical challenges.

  • Adaptable: Flexible and willing to assist across various island operations when required, demonstrating a strong team spirit.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for liaising with suppliers, management, and island staff.

  • Physical Fitness: Physically capable of performing duties that may involve manual handling, lifting, and working in a dynamic environment.

  • Computer Literate: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word) and comfortable with inventory management software.

  • Safety Conscious: A strong commitment to workplace health and safety.

  • Remote Living: A positive and resilient attitude towards living and working in a remote island community.

Benefits:

  • Live-in accommodation provided on Lindeman Island.

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

  • The opportunity to play a vital role in a unique island operation.

  • Be an integral part of a close-knit island team and community.

bulletPoints: Full-time leadership role based in South Australia
Join a proudly Australian, family-owned business
Influence category strategy, promotions, and commercial performance
content.jobHook: Drive category performance through data and insight. Lead analytics, reporting and continuous improvement to shape strategy.
content.unEditedContent:
Join the Haircare Group Family

Haircare Group is a proudly Australian, family-owned business with over 50 years’ experience in the professional hair industry. Founded by a hairdresser for hairdressers, we are a leading distributor of premium haircare brands and services across Australia and New Zealand, supporting customers across wholesale, retail, and eCommerce channels.

We’re more than a business — we’re a community. Our people are passionate about what they do and committed to excellence, innovation, and integrity. We build long-term partnerships with our customers and proudly represent brands that inspire creativity and quality.

For us, it’s more than hair.

The Role

We’re looking for a Category Insights & Strategy Manager to lead our category analytics and insights capability.

Reporting to the General Manager, this role plays a critical part in driving business performance through data-led insights, commercial analysis, and process improvement. You will partner closely with Supply Planning, Sales, and Marketing teams to influence category strategy, promotional effectiveness, and product lifecycle decisions. 

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Influence pricing, promotions, and category growth strategy
  • Work at the intersection of data, commercial decision-making, and operations
  • Partner closely with Supply Planning to shape inventory and demand outcomes
  • Build and scale a high-impact category insights function
  • Drive continuous improvement across reporting and category processes

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver category reporting and dashboards (Power BI) to drive visibility and performance
  • Analyse sales, customer behaviour, and market trends to identify growth opportunities
  • Evaluate NPD, promotions, and product lifecycle performance, including ROI and commercial impact
  • Provide actionable recommendations to improve category strategy, pricing, and promotions
  • Identify opportunities for SKU optimisation and range efficiency
  • Partner cross-functionally to align insights with supply planning, marketing, and commercial execution
  • Lead initiatives to improve category processes, reporting accuracy, and workflows
  • Manage and develop the Promotions Manager to deliver effective campaign execution
  • Present insights and performance updates to senior leadership

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience in data analytics, category insights, or commercial analysis
  • Advanced capability in Power BI or similar reporting tools
  • Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights
  • Experience influencing pricing, promotions, or category decisions
  • Background in wholesale, distribution, or retail environments (preferred)
  • Strong ERP and data analysis capability
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Leadership experience or readiness to step into people leadership
  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or related field (preferred)

What We Offer:

  • Leadership opportunity within a respected Australian-owned business
  • Collaborative and values-driven culture
  • Generous staff discounts on premium haircare products
  • Exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making

Ready to Take the Next Step?

If you’re a commercially minded analyst passionate about turning data into action, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help drive smarter category decisions at Haircare Group.

Please note: You must have full Australian work rights to apply.

content.jobHook: Great opportunity for a Quality Release Coordinator to join our UNCLE TOBYs Wahgunyah Factory.
content.unEditedContent:
Position Snapshot

Location: Wahgunyah, VIC (Northeast Victoria – close to regional hubs of Albury/Wodonga and Wangaratta)
Full time, Permanent role
5+ years’ experience

Position Summary

Opportunity currently exists for a Quality Release Coordinator to join the Quality team based our Wahgunyah Factory, the home of Uncle Toby’s Snacks and Cereals.

The Release Coordinator will be responsible for the operation of the systems related to release of products and materials. Ensure that all products and materials (including finished products, raw materials, packaging materials, rework) are released against Nestlé's requirements.

A day in the life…

Reporting to the QA Manager, key responsibilities include but not limited to: 

  • Responsible for the timely release of all batches of Finished Product, Raw Material, Rework and Packaging that are available for release after midday. 

  • Be the Authorised Person for release of TGA Licenced products.

  • Responsible for release of all batches.

  • Maintenance of lab equipment to required condition including calibration, verification and management. Ordering of consumables.

  • Bulk Raw material Receival management including certificates of analysis and SAP/system release: Eg. Sugar, Wheat flour and Glucose.                              

  • Responsible for the set up and clearance of all morning sensory panels (including packaging and raw materials), re-examination panels and panel results data management. 

  • Responsible for the 5S of the Sensory Lab and the Retention Storage Cage. Responsible for management of the retention samples.

  • Responsible for collection and dispatch of samples to NQAC and external laboratories, and internal testing.

  • Responsible for dispatching pathogen monitoring, water and wastewater swabs.

  • Support the restricted stock process by ensuring all out of spec stock identified after midday is restricted and placed on the Hold list.

What will make you successful

  • Joining a collaborative team of specialists, you will be self-motivated, proactive and have a proven capacity to work effectively within a team environment.

  • Diploma or degree qualified in Laboratory, Food Technology, or related field of study.

  • Previous experience working in a quality or lab-based role – preferred.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills and a proven capacity to influence and negotiate to drive high standards of performance and quality.

  • Passionate about working for Nestlé and sharing its purpose.

Applicants must have full Australian working rights 

Applicants will be required to undergo pre-employment checks, including but not limited to health checks, prior to appointment to this role.

Please note that this role may close earlier than the advertised deadline at our discretion, so we encourage early applications.

Benefits

You will have the chance to work with an outstanding and highly engaged team, build and grow your career with an inclusive, global FMCG leader.

In addition, we offer:

  • Varied career experiences and personalised development support

  • Wellbeing benefits including vaccinations and health insurance discounts

  • Diversity & Inclusion initiatives and program

  • Paid parental and partner leave

  • Purchase Leave Scheme

  • Volunteering leave, Sports leave, Emergency Services leave

  • Discounted Nestlé products

  • Novated Leasing 

  • Salary Sacrifice to Superannuation

Our Story

Nestlé enjoys a reputation as one of the world’s largest FMCG companies and a leader in nutrition, health and wellness. Our inclusive and high-performance culture is a testament to the great training, development, rewards and recognition we extend to every member of our 5000-strong Oceania workforce.

Nestlé Oceania supports a culture of diversity and inclusion in all that we do. Take a look at Careers at Nestlé Australia | Nestlé Australia (nestle.com.au) to see some of the ways we live and practice this every day in our workplace.

For more information please visit our website Nestlé Australia Home | Nestlé Australia (nestle.com.au) or Our LinkedIn page http://www.linkedin.com/company/nestle-s-a-

Apply today!

title: Compliance officer

content.unEditedContent:
Compliance officer/ admin assistant

McCabe Transport (Aust) Pty Ltd 

Pay is Negotiable

McCabe Transport has been in operation in the Wollongong area of New South Wales since 1996.  We are bulk haulage carriers of Industrial waste, scrap steel, gravel products and agricultural products providing services not only locally but both interstate and intrastate. We are NHVR and Truck safe accredited.

We are seeking a bright, energetic, highly organized individual who is passionate about compliance and is ready to take this opportunity to join our team on a full-time permanent basis.


Compliance Applicants will require:

  • Producing month end reports as required

  • Maintain and manage vehicle registrations and permits (NHVAS)

  • Assist with management of records associated with vehicle maintenance.

  • Ensure all employees are appropriately skilled, trained & competent

  • Data entry related to the recording of compliance documentation and records

  • Work dairy entries to maintain drivers hours


The successful Candidates would Require the Following:

  • Strong administrative experience in a similar role

  • Some experience within the transport industry would also be an advantage.

  • You must be able to multi-task and possess a can-do attitude.

  • An ability to prioritize & attention to detail

  • Good communication skills and the ability to work in a small team environment

  • Work unsupervised


If you feel that you would be capabilities for the role, please email accounts@mccabetransport.com.au or call 0406733373

title: Pricing Specialist | Freight Forwarding

bulletPoints: Full time or Long Temp opportunties
content.jobHook: An opportunity to join a succesful pricing team.
content.unEditedContent:
Pricing Specialist | Freight Forwarding
 
An Australian-owned freight forwarding business are seeking experienced Pricing Specialists.
This role could be ideal for both a locally experienced candidate or for someone with overseas freight forwarding experience, including candidates on a long term visa who is looking to step into a commercially focused role within a supportive and established team.
 
Reporting to the Team Leader (based in Perth), you'll be responsible for pricing, quoting, and commercial support across freight forwarding operations.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Pricing & Quoting
  • Prepare accurate and timely quotes for internal stakeholders
  • Respond to pricing and rate requests from sales and operations teams
  • Ensure all costs, margins, and commercial considerations are correctly captured
Tender & Commercial Support
  • Review and analyse tender documentation to understand scope and pricing requirements
  • Support tender submissions with pricing models, cost breakdowns, and supporting documentation
  • Assist with pricing strategies to ensure competitive and profitable outcomes
Systems & Data Management
  • Maintain and update rates and pricing data in CargoWise
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems
Collaboration & Reporting
  • Work closely with the Sales & Develpoment and internal stakeholders
  • Maintain records of pricing activity and provide reporting as required
  • Identify potential commercial risks and flag pricing discrepancies
About You
  • Freight forwarding experience is essential (international or overseas experience would be considered)
  • Previous experience in pricing, quoting, or sales support within freight forwarding ideal
  • CargoWise experience is essential
  • Strong attention to detail and commercial awareness
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • A collaborative team player with a proactive mindset
Whats on Offer
  • Melbourne Tullamarine or Sydney CBD or Brisbane Airport locations
  • Hybrid working model after succesful probation
  • Market-rate salary
  • Potential consideration for internal opportunities if they arise
 
If this sounds like the opportunity you've been waiting for, apply now or contact Caroline Cousins on 0413 889 389 for a confidential discussion.

title: Tactical Planner

bulletPoints: High-impact role with real ownership of the site plan
Work closely with operations and supply chain leaders
12-month contract with potential to become permanent
content.jobHook: Own and execute production plans in a fast-paced FMCG site, balancing demand, capacity, and inventory to keep operations moving.
content.unEditedContent:
Own the plan. Influence the outcome.
 
At Nu-Pure Beverages, we manufacture at scale in a fast-paced FMCG environment, supplying major retailers and private-label partners across Australia.
As we continue to strengthen our supply chain capability, we're looking for a high-performing Tactical Planner to take ownership of the plan at our Stapylton site.
 
Reporting to the National Planning Manager, this role plays a critical part in translating demand into clear, executable production outcomes in a high-volume environment.
 
This is a 12-month max-term parental leave contract, with the potential to become permanent as the business continues to grow.
 
About the Role
This is not a purely transactional planning role — you'll be embedded in site operations, working closely with Production, Procurement, and Supply Chain to make decisions that directly impact performance.
 
You'll need to balance demand, capacity, and material availability in real time, while keeping the plan stable and achievable.
 
This role suits someone comfortable working in a high-volume manufacturing environment where priorities shift quickly — and who can stay in control when they do.
 
What You'll Be Responsible For
  • Owning and managing short- to mid-term production and supply plans
  • Translating demand into clear, executable production schedules
  • Adjusting plans in real time based on changing demand and constraints
  • Working closely with Production to ensure plans are realistic and deliverable
  • Ensuring materials are available to support uninterrupted production
  • Monitoring and actively managing inventory risks
  • Driving alignment across teams when priorities compete
  • Using data and insight to improve planning outcomes
  • Identifying risks early and taking action before they impact performance
 
What Success Looks Like
  • Production runs to plan with minimal disruption driven by planning factors
  • Materials are consistently available to support output
  • Inventory is controlled and optimised
  • Plans are clear, understood, and adjusted quickly when needed
  • You are a trusted, go-to partner across the site
 
About You
You're not just maintaining a plan — you're comfortable owning it, challenging it, and improving it.
You will bring:
  • Experience in production or supply chain planning within an FMCG or manufacturing environment
  • Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data and systems
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP/planning systems (Oracle desirable)
  • Solid understanding of inventory, forecasting, and production scheduling
  • The ability to work closely with operations and influence outcomes on the floor
  • High attention to detail, strong ownership, and a proactive mindset
  • The ability to manage competing priorities without losing control
 
Experience with Power BI or similar tools and exposure to improving planning processes or systems will be highly regarded.
 
Why Join Us
  • Step into ownership - real accountability and visibility across the site
  • High-impact role - your decisions directly influence performance outcomes
  • Fast-paced FMCG environment - suited to capable, high-performing planners
  • Strong exposure - work closely with experienced operations and supply chain leaders
  • Pathway potential - opportunity for the role to become permanent
 
Apply Now
If you're a planner who takes ownership, operates well under pressure, and wants to play a critical role in site performance — we'd love to hear from you.
